stories.headline: CFTC Charges Cash FX Group Over $950M Forex Scheme
stories.summary: Regulators allege the group and three individuals ran a fraud causing at least $406 million in investor losses.
stories.originalTitle: CFTC Sues Cash FX Over Alleged $950M Forex Ponzi Scheme

stories.headline: KelpDAO Developer Sues LayerZero Over $292 Million Exploit
stories.summary: Evercrest Technologies filed a lawsuit in British Columbia against LayerZero and its CEO over an April rsETH exploit.
stories.originalTitle: KelpDAO Sues LayerZero Over $292M Bridge Exploit

stories.headline: Ethena adds tokenized stocks to stablecoin collateral pool
stories.summary: The protocol expanded its backing strategy to include equity perpetuals and tokenized stocks on a major cryptocurrency exchange.
stories.event_rationale: This is a direct protocol update for a major stablecoin, distinct from previous news about USDC or tokenized stock redemptions.
stories.originalTitle: Ethena expands USDe backing strategy into bStocks and equity perpetuals on Binance
